known: Audience: People overwhelmed by their to-do list

Core problem: People overwhelmed by their to-do list face a related cluster of problems around prioritization & daily focus system — e.g. no prioritization on the list, task paralysis from overwhelm, quick vs big tasks not separated.
Evidence on file: Everything lands on one undifferentiated list, so nothing feels urgent and the brain defaults to the easiest task.
Evidence on file: Too many tasks at once triggers overwhelm and freeze — people can't decide where to start (task paralysis).
Evidence on file: No differentiation between quick tasks and big projects, so important deep work is deferred.
